lines: Spring is finished at its round limit: three rounds and none passed
Its last round scored likeness 5 and craft 6 and motion 5 and the jury chose it 5 times of 15
Its 25 severe and major issues are written as open items 109 to 128
Fall closes next when its machine checks arrive
The app is republished with the review page rebuilt
phase 4: 10.77 h used of its 9.50 h box
allowance (before the review): 33.05 h used of 36.00 h allowed
